name: What types of lighting fixtures are commonly used in bathroom upgrades?

mainEntity.name: What types of lighting fixtures are commonly used in bathroom upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bathroom lighting fixtures include vanity lights for task lighting around the mirror, recessed lighting for general illumination, and shower lights for wet areas. Accent lighting, such as sconces or LED strip lighting, can also enhance the room's ambiance. When planning an upgrade, consider a layered lighting approach to ensure functionality and aesthetics. Each type serves a distinct purpose, from bright task lighting for grooming to softer ambient light for relaxation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common bathroom lighting fixtures include vanity lights, recessed lights, and shower lights, often used in a layered approach for optimal functionality and ambiance.
